entries.clue: Roast swan, spiced pastries and far more courses than anybody needed
Fortified stronghold looming over a city, as at Aleppo or Cairo
Steep cone of piled earth thrown up to carry a Norman lord's first fort
Ring the walls, cut the roads, then wait: hunger does the rest
Lustrous, hairy yarn shorn from a long-haired goat, knitted up into a fuzzy halo
Patterned perch you dive for the moment somebody stands up at their stop
Square of red carpets and film premieres, with its own stop right beneath
Pass bought by the week, month or year rather than journey by journey
Sum demanded before a captive lord is handed back to his own people
Pivoted blades kept for cloth alone, never lent out for paper
Sealed little box at the sharp end, with room for one person and the controls
Small reel below the plate that supplies the lower thread on a machine
